Name: Jelly's pixel art anime portraits
Author: MatchaJ3lly
Description:
[b][size=3]The files here only contain portraits! You have to manually replace them in whichever mod(s) you're using.[/size][/b]

I've just started trying my hands on pixel art so I thought I'll work on some portrait replacements for SVE and HB as practice.
I'll appreciate feedback on what to improve on if you do use them! They're not 100% yet.
I'm aiming to (hopefully) do the full cast.

NOTE! I've not played on HB yet I'm hoping to complete more casts before I do so if the portraits are not working let me know!

[b][i]The main file contains ALL current available portraits in their respective folders (SVE, HB, Vanilla) to get just one without the rest I've listed them separately in the optional files portion.[/i][/b]
